description: Implementation of QuicStreamIdManager class managing stream IDs in QUIC protocol.

classes.name: QuicStreamIdManager
classes.description: Manages stream IDs for a QUIC connection, handling stream creation, limits, and state.

methods.name: QuicStreamIdManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing stream ID manager with configuration parameters.

methods.name: OnStreamsBlockedFrame
methods.description: Handles a frame indicating streams are blocked, updating flow control accordingly.

methods.name: MaybeAllowNewOutgoingStreams
methods.description: Adjusts the maximum allowed outgoing streams if increased.

methods.name: SetMaxOpenIncomingStreams
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of incoming streams and updates internal state.

methods.name: MaybeSendMaxStreamsFrame
methods.description: Decides whether to send a MAX_STREAMS frame based on window size.

methods.name: SendMaxStreamsFrame
methods.description: Sends a MAX_STREAMS frame to the peer.

methods.name: OnStreamClosed
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a stream is closed, possibly increasing stream limits.

methods.name: GetNextOutgoingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the next available outgoing stream ID.

methods.name: CanOpenNextOutgoingStream
methods.description: Checks if a new outgoing stream can be opened.

methods.name: MaybeIncreaseLargestPeerStreamId
methods.description: Attempts to update the largest peer-created stream ID, validating limits.

methods.name: IsAvailableStream
methods.description: Checks if a stream ID is available for use.

methods.name: GetFirstOutgoingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the first stream ID for outgoing streams based on configuration.

methods.name: GetFirstIncomingStreamId
methods.description: Returns the first stream ID for incoming streams based on configuration.

methods.name: available_incoming_streams
methods.description: Returns the number of available incoming streams.
